fields.statement: Change set 01M6JZD: an interrupted plan run whose record change set has landed (a milestone plan lands its record mid-interview) can now be continued by `rhiza run resume`, but the daemon's Resumable (internal/daemon/pick.go) resumes only runs whose change set is accepted, and the inbox (internal/api/inbox.go ~249) lists the run as skipped with `rhiza run abandon`. What should the daemon do with such a run? / Change set 01M6JZD: the inbox also hides a failed or gave-up run when its change set is terminal (gone() in inbox.go), which hides a failed plan run on a landed record even though `rhiza run resume --retry` works on it. Should this change set also stop hiding those?
